spec_features.spec_quote: Episode ends if: all tests pass (success), model abandons, or MAX_TURNS
spec_features.evidence: agent.py:127 `for i in range(config.MAX_TURNS):` with `else: res.end_reason = 'max_turns'` (172) enforces the turn cap, and `if tests_passed: res.solved=True; ... break` (168-170) enforces the success exit. But the third disjunct, 'model abandons', is NOT enforced: the only break out of the loop is tests passing; abandonment is only detected post-hoc by the judge as a flag (judge.py _FLAG_LEX task_abandonment) and never stops the loop. Even the mock 'I give up' turn (providers.py:207) does not halt the episode.
spec_features.notes: Two of three claimed end conditions are real and enforced; the 'model abandons' condition has no enforcing code path. Hence partial.
spec_features.code_justification_quote: MAX_TURNS = 12  # how long we let the model grind

spec_features.evidence: agent.py:127 `for i in range(config.MAX_TURNS):` bounds the loop; the for-else at 171-172 sets `res.end_reason = 'max_turns'` when the cap is hit. config.MAX_TURNS=12 (config.py:34) is actually read and bounds execution.
spec_features.notes: Genuinely enforced hard cap on episode length.
spec_features.code_justification_quote: MAX_TURNS = 12  # how long we let the model grind

spec_features.evidence: No abandon/exit/finish/stop tool exists. Available tools are only read_file, write_file, list_files, run_tests (agent.py SYSTEM_PROMPT lines 14-38; tools.py execute_tool dispatch 153-170 has no exit handler). 'abandon'/'task_abandonment' appears only as a judge classification (judge.py:60 _FLAG_LEX) computed AFTER the episode in run_experiment.py (judge_turn loop ~133-136), never feeding back to break the loop. The loop's only early break is `if tests_passed: break` (agent.py:168-170). Mock subject emitting 'I give up' (providers.py:207) does not stop the episode.
spec_features.notes: Abandonment is measured, not honored as a stop. No mechanism lets the subject exit.
